stem: What was a major reason for the federal government's involvement in the relocations depicted on this map?

options.label: A
options.text: To persuade American Indians to become farmers

options.label: B
options.text: To gain access to important rivers

options.label: C
options.text: To punish American Indians who were allies of the British

options.label: D
options.text: To acquire valuable agricultural land and natural resources

visual_elements: Map titled 'Relocation of American Indians in the 1830s' showing arrows of relocation from states like Georgia, Alabama, Tennessee, and Mississippi to the Indian Territory (present-day Oklahoma). Labels include states: MO, AR, LA, MS, AL, KY, TN, GA, SC, NC, VA, OH, IN, IL, PA, MD, and FL. Also marked are 'Indian Territory,' 'Disputed Territory,' 'Republic of Texas,' and 'Mexico.' Various Native American tribes are labeled: Chickasaw, Cherokee, Creek, Choctaw, Seminole.
